description: List every launch kit for a feature built behind a release flag, for Last Price staff only: the flag's state, readiness (how many checks pass, warn and fail, and what blocks), the go code, what is scheduled, whether the launcher is on, and the release flags that have no kit yet. Read only: it never switches, schedules or sends anything; launching needs the owner's go code through the launch command. Needs an API key holding the launches:read scope by name, made by someone who is still Last Price staff, sent as x-api-key or as Authorization: Bearer lp_...; any other credential gets 404. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: list_feature_launches
